A fresh look, search that's always within reach, and an installer that opens files almost instantly.

## What's new

- **A new design.** A calmer, more polished look throughout: the Plus Jakarta Sans typeface, flat cards edged with a fine hairline, a soft glow behind each screen, and redesigned Install and Settings screens.
- **Search beside the tab bar.** A round search button sits next to the tab bar. Tap it and the search field washes in over the tabs; tap ✕ to clear the search and bring the tabs back.
- **Search your History.** Find a saved file by app name, package, version or file name. Matching files stay grouped by app, with the match highlighted.
- **Filter chips.** Show all apps, only split APKs or only single APKs with one tap. The sort button now sits at the end of the chips.
- **Clearer glass.** The tab bar, search field, top bars and toasts are more see-through, and look right in light mode too.
- **Toasts that match what happened.** Deleting files shows a red trash icon. Removing items from History without deleting files shows a grey one. Successful actions stay green.
- **Clear All, redesigned.** A soft red button with a trash icon, so it's clearly the destructive action. It still asks before deleting anything.

## Faster installs

- **Files open almost instantly.** Picking an APK or bundle no longer copies it first. Only the parts needed to show the app's name, version and icon are read, and the signature is read straight from the file. The app is streamed from the file when you tap Install, so large bundles open fast and need no extra storage.
- **A steadier install sheet.** The sheet keeps its size from the moment it opens, so it slides up once without stopping or jumping, and shows progress as a ring around the app icon.

## Fixes

- Saved files keep their app icon in History after the app is uninstalled.

## Download

Get **`apk-extractor-v2.0.0.apk`**. Requires Android 7.0 or newer. It updates earlier versions in place, keeping your settings and history. Android may offer to scan the app before installing, because it doesn't come from the Play Store. Tap "Scan app" and it will install normally.
